summary: Build practical SOC, SIEM, triage, and incident-response capabilities. Explore the five-day course and request training details.
lede: SOC operations training helps analysts, security engineers, incident responders and cybersecurity leads build practical monitoring and response workflows. Learners practise specifying SIEM use cases, mapping detections to threat techniques, and assessing and escalating alerts; they also draft incident playbooks and a performance scorecard. The course introduces AI-assisted triage and detection automation, with exercises shaped around available people, data and tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate, support, or oversee security monitoring and incident response, including teams working with constrained staffing, mixed technology environments, or outsourced SOC services.
prerequisites: Prior experience in IT operations, cybersecurity, network administration, or security monitoring is recommended. You should be familiar with common security alerts and basic incident-handling terms. Coding is not required; exercises focus on sample event records, detection logic, workflows, and reporting.
